name: Metal Plate
description: The demo's biggest bottleneck. It appears in almost every boat module, repair and tool recipe — pull every floating container you pass with the Hook Gun.

name: Rubber
description: Salvaged from tyres and rubber debris. Needed for hull protection, propellers and several tool recipes.

name: Rope
description: Found in barrels, crates and the opening house. Stock up early — hull work and braided line both want it.

name: Coral Fibers
description: Harvested from coral growths on Angler's Island with the Axe. Required for John's Moonshine Still and most hull-side recipes.

name: Bug Slime
locations: Small blue creatures on the water (Hook Gun)
usedIn: Hull patching at the Dry Dock
description: Pulled from the small blue creatures on the water with the Hook Gun. Keep spare — Dry Dock hull repairs consume it too.

name: Gear
description: Mechanical salvage from wreck containers. Engines and reels both compete for it.

name: Machine Oil
description: Workshop salvage also sold by traders. Reserved for engine work.

name: Carburetor
locations: Betsy and Sons shop (50, after the 3-Harpooner contract)
description: A purchased part, not salvage. The Harpooner delivery unlocks the shop listing; you still have to open the shop and buy it.

name: Impeller
description: Mechanical salvage reserved for propeller work.

name: Thermo Coil
description: Electrical salvage also needed at The Throat gate. Do not spend the last one on bait before the gate.

name: Cable
locations: Electrical salvage in the Dry Dock
description: Electrical salvage. One cable repairs the Dry Dock fuse box; keep more for the Spotlight and Deadly Tick.

name: Relay Tubes
description: Electrical salvage used only for the Spotlight module.

name: Chromatic Scales
locations: Process Softgrazers at the Thresher (Betsy and Sons)
description: The second great bottleneck. Hull protection, Rainbow Fin, Sturdy Earcrawler and the Spotlight all want scales — process extra Softgrazers whenever the spot is active.

name: Fish Meat
description: Ground from caught fish at the Grinder. Feeds both the bait recipes and the Fuel Larva production chain.

name: Jaws
locations: Process predatory fish at the Grinder or Thresher
description: Harvested from predator catches. Flaming Belly competes with two tool upgrades for it.

name: Lily
description: Gathered from aquatic plants in the swamp shallows. Only Flaming Belly needs it.

name: Battery
description: Electrical salvage used for the Sturdy Earcrawler lure.

name: Circuit Board
description: Electrical salvage reserved for the Deadly Tick bait.

name: Sturdy Metal
description: Heavy salvage from reinforced crates, used only for Deadly Tick.

name: Sharpfin Flesh
description: Cut from the level 50 Sharpfin. The rarest ingredient chain in the demo data.

name: Gas Cylinder
description: Workshop salvage feeding the Afterburner module.

name: Torn Pages (Scraps of Knowledge)
description: The research currency. The inventory item is called Scraps of Knowledge; the tech trees call them Torn Pages. Spend on main-quest blueprints first.

name: Rusty Scrap Metal
usedIn: Engine repairs (3–5 per repair depending on engine)
description: The engine repair material. Every engine tier is repaired with it, so keep a small reserve aboard.
